MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL: normal volatility at 28.6% and mixed breadth, with 4/8 sectors positive. Neither signal points to a decisive risk-on or risk-off stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology & Telecom leads on the week at +2.56%, with KONTR (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +52.94%) ABOVE TREND; Transportation is next at +1.94%, led by PGSUS (1W: +2.85% | 1M: +24.35%) ABOVE TREND. Heavy Industry is also positive weekly, but its sector 1M return remains negative.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Holding & Investment is weakest on the week at -3.97%, followed by Banking & Finance at -3.36%; SAHOL (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -2.70%) is BELOW TREND. Retail & Food also lags at -2.37%, with SOKM (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -24.55%) BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
VESTL (1W: +16.92% | 1M: -5.59%) leads in RECOVERY; KONTR (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +52.94%) is ABOVE TREND. CCOLA (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +2.80%) is ABOVE TREND, while TUPRS (1W: +4.23% | 1M: -8.06%) is in RECOVERY and BIMAS (1W: +3.15% | 1M: +3.22%) is ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
SOKM (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -24.55%) and ULKER (1W: -8.53% | 1M: -10.63%) are BELOW TREND. HALKB (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -4.78%), SAHOL (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -2.70%) and ARCLK (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -10.46%) are also BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
The strongest weekly moves are VESTL (1W: +16.92% | 1M: -5.59%) in RECOVERY, KONTR (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +52.94%) ABOVE TREND, and CCOLA (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND. TUPRS (1W: +4.23% | 1M: -8.06%) is in RECOVERY, while BIMAS (1W: +3.15% | 1M: +3.22%) remains ABOVE TREND.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance fell 3.36% on the week despite a positive 1M sector return; AKBNK (1W: -2.33% | 1M: +3.29%), GARAN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +13.08%), ISCTR (1W: -4.47% | 1M: +1.24%) and YKBNK (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +4.65%) are all in CORRECTION. Near-term momentum is weak, though monthly returns remain positive across these names.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry gained 1.45% weekly but is down 4.37% over the month; VESTL (1W: +16.92% | 1M: -5.59%) and KRDMD (1W: +2.28% | 1M: -6.64%) are in RECOVERY. TOASO (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +0.41%) and ASELS (1W: +1.34% | 1M: +0.37%) are ABOVE TREND, while EREGL (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -12.13%) is BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
The sector remains weak, down 1.34% weekly and 10.74% monthly; TUPRS (1W: +4.23% | 1M: -8.06%) is in RECOVERY. SASA (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -9.83%), SISE (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -5.14%) and HEKTS (1W: -4.09% | 1M: -19.21%) are BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a neutral, selective stance: normal volatility and mixed breadth offer no strong regime signal. Favor confirmed relative strength over broad exposure, while keeping risk limits tight around weak sectors and stocks in BELOW TREND.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Monitor KONTR (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +52.94%) ABOVE TREND and PGSUS (1W: +2.85% | 1M: +24.35%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through. VESTL (1W: +16.92% | 1M: -5.59%) and TUPRS (1W: +4.23% | 1M: -8.06%) are in RECOVERY; watch whether weekly strength persists.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Track Transportation, up 1.94% weekly and 18.03% monthly, and Technology & Telecom, up 2.56% weekly and 17.60% monthly. Energy & Chemicals remains a watchpoint on weakness, with sector returns of -1.34% weekly and -10.74% monthly.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XU100 support and resistance levels were not provided, so specific index levels cannot be stated. Key regime triggers are a change in volatility from the current 28.6% and a shift in breadth from 4/8 positive sectors.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The market is NEUTRAL, with normal volatility and mixed breadth; leadership is concentrated in Technology & Telecom and Transportation. KONTR and PGSUS show confirmed positive trends, while weak breadth in Banking, Retail and Energy & Chemicals argues for selectivity and disciplined risk management.
